parse.title: A Night at the Theatre/Quick guide
parse.wikitext:
===Memories of a "Friend"===
{{Needed|Combat gear, some food, [[ivandis flail]] or [[blisterwood flail]], [[Saw]], one dose of [[anti-venom]] or two doses of [[antipoison]]|recommended=[[Ectophial]] for fast access to [[Port Phasmatys]], [[Drakan's medallion]], [[Super energy]] or [[Stamina potions]]}}
{{Checklist|
*Talk to the [[Mysterious Stranger]] by the entrance to the [[Theatre of Blood]].
**''No Theatre of Blood raids completed:''{{Chat option|2What's all this really about?|1Yes.}}
**''Completed at least 1 Theatre of Blood raid:''{{Chat option|1Speaking of your associates, what's all this really about?|1Yes.}}
*Go down the stairs to the north-east of the Mysterious Stranger. Bring a [[saw]] and [[blisterwood flail]].
*Kill a [[vyrewatch]] for a key.
*Unlock the gate to the south and open the coffin.
*Return to the Mysterious Stranger with [[Ranis' head]] and watch the cutscene. {{Chat option|1Yes.}}
*Go to the [[Morytania Spider Cave|dungeon (cave)]] north of [[Darkmeyer]] (south of [[Port Phasmatys]]).
*Follow the path north, then east to the egg sac.
*Search the nearby skeleton.
*Read the [[sticky note]].
*Speak to [[Daer Krand]] {{Chat option|3Got any sulphuric acid?}} in the [[Sisterhood Sanctuary]] to obtain [[sulphuric acid]]. 
**The entrance is located south of the graveyard in Slepe.
**To reach Daer Krand, make your way toward the centre of the sanctuary, then follow the path east, then north. He is located upstairs.
*Return to the dungeon (cave) north of Darkmeyer.
*Use [[sulphuric acid]] on the egg sac. You do not need to kill any spiders.
**The spiders here can [[envenom]] you. Drink a dose of [[anti-venom]] or two doses of [[anti-poison]] to cure it.
*Return to the Mysterious Stranger {{Chat option|1I found some of those eggs.}} with the [[strange spider eggs]]. Watch two cutscenes.
}}
